images.filename: California Zephyr dome car Algoma Central Railway.jpg
images.caption: A better shot at the end of the day.  This California Zephyr dome car formerly known as Silver Palace now belongs to Canada's Algoma Central Railway. The Budd Company built #813 Silver Palace in 1948-1949 for the Western Pacific as part of the original California Zephyr. The Vista-Dome coach sat 46 in the lower level and accommodated 24 in non-revenue seating in the dome.
images.alt: A better shot at the end of the day.  This California Zephyr dome car formerly known as Silver Palace now belongs to Canada's Algoma Central Railway. The Budd Company built #813 Silver Palace in 1948-1949 for the Western Pacific as part of the original California Zephyr. The Vista-Dome coach sat 46 in the lower level and accommodated 24 in non-revenue seating in the dome.
